{{Use Nigerian English|date=August 2026}} {{Use dmy dates|date=August 2026}} The '''2026–27 Nigeria Premier Football League''' (officially known as the '''Euromatch Premier Football League''' for sponsorship reasons){{Cite news|url=https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/08/26/7-5m-boost-euromatch-signs-3-year-deal-to-become-npfl-title-sponsor/|title=$7.5 million dollars boost: Euromatch signs 3-year deal to become NFL title sponsor|date=26 August 2026|newspaper=[[This Day]]}} is the 56th season of Nigeria's top-flight [[association football]] league and the 37th since attaining professionalism. The season commences on 28 August 2026 and will conclude on 30 May 2027, with a two-week mid-season break from December 23 to January 6.{{cite web|url=https://dailypost.ng/2026/06/30/npfl-sets-august-28-kick-off-date-for-2026-27-season/|title=NPFL sets August 28 kick-off date for 2026/27 season|work=[[Daily Post (Nigeria)|Daily Post Nigeria]]|date=30 June 2026|author=Mike Oyebola}} {{Infobox football league season | image = | competition = [[Nigeria Premier Football League]] | season = 2026–27 | dates = 28 August 2026 – 30 May 2027 | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = [[2027–28 CAF Champions League|Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = [[2027–28 CAF Confederation Cup|Confederation Cup]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | matches =80 | total goals =193 | league topscorer = | best goalkeeper = | biggest home win = [[Rivers United]] 5–0 [[Kun Khalifat]] (24 September 2026) | biggest away win = [[Inter Lagos]] 0–3 [[Sporting Lagos]] (13 September 2026) | highest scoring = [[Bendel Insurance]] 4–2 Kun Khalifat (13 September 2026)
Kun Khalifat 2–4 [[Enugu Rangers]] (20 September 2026)
[[Enyimba F.C.|Enyimba]] 4–2 [[Shooting Stars F.C.|Shooting Stars]] (30 September 2026)
[[Katsina United]] 4–2 Enyimba (9 October 2026) | longest wins = [[Doma United]] & Enugu Rangers (3 matches) | longest unbeaten = [[Rivers United]] (8 matches) | longest winless = Enyimba (5 matches) | longest losses = Enyimba (4 matches) | most yellow card = | most red card = | most goals scored (team) = | most goals conceded (team) = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Nigeria Premier Football League|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Nigeria Professional Football League|2027–28]] | updated = 11 October 2026 | league topscorer section = }} The season sees a reported increase in the league champion prize to ₦1 billion ($741,279) and a deal with Murphy Ben International to [[live streaming|stream]] matches on [[YouTube]].{{Cite news|url=https://punchng.com/nsc-raises-npfl-winners-prize-to-n1bn/|title=NSC raises NPFL winner's prize to N1bn|date=24 June 2026|newspaper=[[The Punch]]}}{{cite web|url=https://npfl.com.ng/2026/08/13/npfl-partners-murphy-ben-international-for-youtube-streaming/|title=NPFL partners Murphy Ben International for YouTube streaming|work=[[Nigeria Premier Football League|npfl.com.ng]]|date=13 August 2026}} ==Teams== ===Changes from previous season=== Twenty teams, consisting of the top sixteen teams from the previous season and four promoted teams from the [[Nigeria National League]], are competing in the league. The promoted teams are NNL champions [[Sporting Lagos]], along with debutants [[Inter Lagos F.C.|Inter Lagos]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.premiumtimesng.com/sports/football/872375-sporting-lagos-clinch-npfl-promotion.html|title=Sporting Lagos clinch NPFL promotion|date=16 April 2026|newspaper=[[Premium Times]]}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/869877-inter-lagos-seal-historic-npfl-promotion.html|title=Inter Lagos seal historic NPFL promotion|date=7 April 2026|newspaper=[[Premium Times]]}} [[Doma United]] are also making a return since the [[2023–24 Nigeria Premier Football League|2023–24 season]] while [[Ranchers Bees]] makes a return since the [[2009–10 Nigeria Premier League|2009–10 season]]. The four replace [[Remo Stars]], [[El-Kanemi Warriors]], [[Bayelsa United]] and [[Wikki Tourists]] who all got relegated the [[2025–26 Nigeria Premier Football League|previous season]].{{cite web|url=https://dailypost.ng/2026/03/26/nnl-doma-united-secure-promotion-to-npfl/|title=Doma United secure promotion to NPFL|work=Daily Post|date=26 March 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.aclsports.com/ranchers-bees-complete-npfl-return-after-16-years/|title=Ranchers Bees complete NPFL return after 16 years|work=aclsports.com|date=22 April 2026}} For the first time since 1996, three teams from [[Lagos]] will be participating in a NPFL season.{{cite web|url=https://guardian.ng/news/2026-2027-npfl-lagos-derbies-return-as-ikorodu-city-inter-lagos-sporting-lagos-reignite-rivalry/|title=2026/27 NPFL: Lagos derbies return as Ikorodu City, Inter Lagos and Sporting Lagos reignite rivalry|work=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]|last=Ashaolu|first=Oluwafemi|date=26 April 2026}} {| class="wikitable" |- ! {{increase}} Promoted from
